title: VM workspace settings show safe selections, pending status and stale-save recovery
scope: Synthetic browser integration through production ModalStack, VM editor and API adapter. Live backend pending/applied behavior is covered separately by vm-owner-api-proof configuration.

steps.assert: Applied settings load; credential secret is absent from the rendered page
Choose Work account and Service, save, and observe restart-required status without lifecycle actions
Advance the synthetic server version, deselect Service and save; conflict preserves the unsaved selection and explains reload
Reload restores saved selections; simulate healthy application and reload to show applied status
Only configuration saves occur, with original expected versions 2 and 3; no legacy mutations or unexpected console/network errors
